settlementToken.name: Mock USDG
settlementToken.faucet: faucet() mints 1000e6 (1,000 tokens) per address per 86400s; FAUCET_AMOUNT/FAUCET_COOLDOWN read on-chain, mintLocked=true so the faucet is the only open supply
settlementToken.verified: 2026-09-13 — source-verified on the explorer as src/mocks/MockUSDG.sol (creation tx 0x78a713a5d9b5d897f47809ead0f8afd540c0a0dae34c47903a028d471756e089, admin 0x0b64B35c6Dd23944D6D4029864D2cA2AA1B66422); live claim tx 0x6e8c867dfb0f9b2b057bac9cbe6fc82979dac7ec701f1b7cdb0af1bc8a4122e6 minted exactly 1000000000 and the immediate retry reverted FaucetCooldown(1789363365)
settlementToken.why: Testnet only, and only because the official testnet USDG drip has never funded a protocol wallet — premiums, vault reserves and payouts have to be exercisable to be verifiable. 6 decimals like USDG, so no protocol math differs; ProtectionNote reads decimals() from vault.token() at runtime.
settlementToken.mainnet: Chain 4663 defaults to canonical USDG 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168, and DeployConfig.settlementToken() reverts MockTokenOnMainnet if the mock is ever paired with 4663. SETTLEMENT_TOKEN overrides either default; switching testnet back to official USDG (0x7E955252E15c84f5768B83c41a71F9eba181802F) is that one env line plus a redeploy.

TSLA.feedType: DemoFeed — owner-set testnet stand-in; Chainlink publishes no feeds on 46630 (mainnet only). NOT market data. Swap to the real Chainlink feed unchanged when available.

demoFeeds.note: Deployed via script/DemoFeed.s.sol, initial prices default $100 (TSLA $250). Only TSLA is registered in the asset registry. Feeds persist across v2/v3/v4 redeploys.

verification: All four v4 protocol contracts source-verified on the explorer (solc 0.8.35, optimizer 200 runs, constructor args included for the vault and the note; the registry and oracle matched by bytecode).
notes: v4 redeployed for one reason: SherwoodVault.token is immutable, so the v3 vault will forever point at official testnet USDG, a token no protocol wallet has ever received. v3/v2/v1 are abandoned with zero funds and superseded.

Wiring read back from chain after deploy: vault.token() = MockUSDG, vault.noteContract() = the new note, vault.bufferBps() = 2000, note.{registry,oracle,vault} all correct, registry.getAsset(TSLA) = registered + active, vault owner = deployer.
Live read-path proof on v4: quote(0.1 TSLA, 80%, 1d) returned premium 5.625e17 USD-18 ($0.5625) and floor 2e19 ($20.00) — identical to v3 and to the spec formula at the DemoFeed price of $250.
Position guard is unchanged in v4 (create() reverts InsufficientPosition unless the caller holds the protected stock); proven on-chain in the v3 simulation on 2026-09-12 and covered by tests since.

Demo write path is now fundable but has not been run: script/Faucet.s.sol claims 1,000 MockUSDG per address per 24h, script/DemoCreate.s.sol then deposits to the vault and buys a 1-day note, and script/DemoSettle.s.sol settles it after expiry. Deliberately held pending the operator's go-ahead.

Frontend still defaults to the v3 addresses and official USDG in frontend/lib/addresses.ts — it must be repointed at this v4 stack and MockUSDG before the app is used against testnet. Held until the operator asks for frontend work.

Deploy note for this chain: forge script needs --private-key passed explicitly here; relying on the PRIVATE_KEY env var alone left the broadcast using Foundry's default sender and nothing was signed (the first v4 attempt produced zero deployed code). Also expects an EIP-3855/PUSH0 warning for chain 46630 — v1 through v4 all deployed and execute fine.
